title: The Page Stuck in the Printer
story: Hana needed to print her story before the class bell. The school printer made a loud click and then stopped. A message on the screen showed a picture of a stuck page. Hana read the steps and opened the front panel. She pulled out a folded sheet and closed the panel gently. The printer started again, and her story came out on clean paper. She checked that every paragraph was there. The teacher had asked the class to keep a backup as well. Hana saved a copy on a memory stick and put the stick in her pencil case. She wrote her name on the printed page and placed it in the tray. A classmate named Rafi had the same problem a minute later. Hana showed him the picture and waited while he removed his page. Both stories printed, and they reached the classroom on time.
